content_zh:
“依依，三年未见，你越来越漂亮了。”萧大山声音洪亮，看着面前的少女。
那少女十四岁上下，身穿紫色纱裙，明眸皓齿，婀娜多姿，清丽脱俗，让人见之眼前一亮，牢牢吸引着屋内一众少年的目光。
“大山叔说笑了。”柳依依微微笑道。
在她身旁，还站着一位背负长剑的白袍少年。那少年十六岁左右，高大英武，眉宇间带着桀骜之色，对屋内的村民不屑一顾。
“依依，这位是？”萧大山看向那位白袍少年。
“他是我师兄，名为赵乾，这次陪我一同回村子探亲。”柳依依笑着解释道。
重阳门弟子？
屋内村民一怔，旋即好奇的看过去，重阳门的弟子，那可都是天才人物啊，不是村内的小辈可比的。
“哼！”白袍少年赵乾高傲的说道，“依妹，别和这些乡巴佬废话了，动作快点！”
乡巴佬？
这刺耳的称呼，让众多村民呼吸一滞，旋即恼怒起来，怒视着赵乾，萧大山面色也变得很难看。
“赵乾师兄，别这样。”柳依依轻轻摇头，对众人歉意道，“众位叔叔伯伯，这次我回来探亲，是为了报答你们的养育之恩，这‘炼体丹’，我送给你们。”
柳依依拿出一个锦盒，小心震。
“炼体丹！”萧大山猛然失声，激动的接了过来。
听到萧大山的惊呼，屋内所有人都瞪大双眼，目光炽热的盯着锦盒。特别是屋内的萧腾，满脸贪婪之色。
炼体丹，可以让炼体境武者炼体速度大增，价值不菲，萧腾日思夜想很久了，如今怎能不激动？
“真是一群乡巴佬，三颗炼体丹，就让你们高兴成这样。”白袍少年赵乾嗤笑一声，满脸的嘲讽。
任村民脾气再好，此刻也忍不住了。
“小子，你说什么？”一众村民盯着白袍少年，面色不善。
面对众人愤怒的目光，赵乾冷笑道：“今天我和依妹一起前来，就是为了通知你们，三颗炼体丹，买断养育之恩，依妹以后和你们再无关系，我不希望看到，你们这群乡巴佬，以后再去纠缠依妹！”

“依妹有我们重阳门的栽培，前途无量，你们这群乡巴佬，高攀不起！”
白袍少年赵乾一字一句，态度无比的高傲，将村们的怒火彻底点燃了。
三颗炼体丹，买断养育之恩？
人非草木，孰能无情！
柳依依自小在萧家村中长大，村民早就将她当成了村子的一份子，当成了家人，从未亏待柳依依半分。
这种亲情，岂能用炼体丹来衡量？赵乾凭什么代替柳依依做出这样的决定？
“再无关系，也包括我吗？”
就在这时，一道声音传来，众人闻声看去，只见一位身穿粗布麻衣的俊秀少年，走入了屋中。
来人，正是萧叶。
他在屋外听到赵乾的话，心情瞬间沉入了谷底。
“哦？你是谁？”赵乾看着萧叶，高傲的问道。
萧叶却并不答话，目光一瞬不瞬的盯着柳依依，那个让他等了三年的少女，他需要的，是柳依依的答案。
“萧哥哥……”柳依依表情复杂，轻咬红唇。
望着近在咫尺的少女，萧叶心头轻颤，他深吸口气，大声道：“告诉我，你这次回来，难道就是为了和我们划清界限的？”
萧叶清秀面容中含着一抹凌厉，让柳依依一时间不知道该怎么回答。
“看来，你有些认不清现实啊。”白袍少年赵乾一步踏出，双手负在身后，冷笑道，“我早就听依妹提起过你，你是萧家村的第一天才。”
“不过你这个天才，在我眼中，连狗。屎都不如！”
赵乾话音落下，顿时一股浩瀚澎湃的真气爆发，从他身上席卷开来，将身旁的几位村民震飞出去，狠狠的撞在墙壁上，一口鲜血喷了出来。
“先天境界！”
感受着那股浩瀚的气息，萧大山内心狠狠一颤，不可置信的望着赵乾。

后天境界之上，便是先天之境！
这个境界的武者，体内蕴含先天真气，可以离体攻击，堪称万人敌，可在千军万马中厮杀，一拳轰碎山峰。
赵乾看上去不过十六岁，但实力却达到了先天之境。要知道，整个青阳镇，还从未出现过一位先天境武者。
十六岁的先天武者，这样的资质，也太可怕了吧！难道这才是真正的天才吗？

content_en:
"Yiyi, I haven't seen you for three years, and you are getting more and more beautiful." Xiao Dashan said in a loud voice, looking at the girl in front of him.
The girl was about fourteen years old. She was wearing a purple gauze skirt. She had bright eyes and white teeth. She was graceful and elegant. She was eye-catching and attracted the attention of all the young people in the room.
"Uncle Dashan was joking." Liu Yiyi smiled slightly.
Beside her stood a young man in white robe with a sword on his back. The young man was about sixteen years old, tall and heroic, with an unruly look on his eyebrows, and he looked down upon the villagers in the house.
"Yiyi, who is this?" Xiao Dashan looked at the young man in white robe.
"He is my senior brother, named Zhao Qian. This time he accompanied me back to the village to visit relatives." Liu Yiyi explained with a smile.
A disciple of the Chongyang Sect?
The villagers in the room were startled, and then looked over curiously. The disciples of the Chongyang Sect were all geniuses, and they were not comparable to the juniors in the village.
"Hmph!" Zhao Qian, a young man in white robe, said arrogantly, "Yimei, stop talking nonsense to these country bumpkins and move quickly!"
Country bumpkin?
This harsh name made many villagers hold their breath, and they immediately became angry and glared at Zhao Qian. Xiao Dashan's face also became ugly.
"Senior Brother Zhao Qian, don't be like this." Liu Yiyi shook her head gently and apologized to everyone, "Uncles and uncles, I came back to visit my relatives this time to repay your kindness in raising me. I will give you this 'Body Refining Pill'."
Liu Yiyi took out a brocade box and was cautious.
"Body Refining Pill!" Xiao Dashan suddenly lost his voice and took it excitedly.
Hearing Xiao Dashan's exclamation, everyone in the room widened their eyes and stared at the brocade box with burning eyes. Especially Xiao Teng in the room, his face was full of greed.
The body refining pill can greatly increase the speed of body refining for warriors in the body refining realm. It is worth a lot of money. Xiao Teng has been thinking about it day and night for a long time. How can he not be excited now?
"What a bunch of country bumpkins. Three Body Refining Pills can make you so happy." Zhao Qian, a young man in white robe, sneered, his face full of ridicule.
No matter how good-tempered the villagers were, they couldn't bear it anymore.
"Boy, what did you say?" The villagers stared at the white-robed boy with unkind expressions.
Facing the angry looks of everyone, Zhao Qian sneered: "I came here with Yimei today just to inform you that with three body refining pills, I will buy out the grace of raising you. Yimei will have nothing to do with you in the future. I don't want to see you country bumpkins pestering Yimei again in the future!"
"Yimei has a bright future thanks to the cultivation of our Chongyang Sect. You country bumpkins can't reach that high!"
The white-robed young man Zhao Gan spoke with an extremely arrogant attitude, completely igniting the villagers' anger.
Three body refining pills, buying off the grace of upbringing?
Humans are not like vegetation, how can they be ruthless!
Liu Yiyi grew up in Xiaojia Village. The villagers have long regarded her as a member of the village and as a family member, and have never treated Liu Yiyi unfairly.
How can this kind of family affection be measured by the Body Refining Pill? Why did Zhao Qian make such a decision on behalf of Liu Yiyi?
"It doesn't matter anymore, does it include me?"
At this moment, a voice came, and everyone looked around and saw a handsome young man wearing coarse linen clothes walking into the house.
The person who came was none other than Xiao Ye.
When he heard Zhao Qian's words outside the house, his mood instantly sank to the bottom.
"Oh? Who are you?" Zhao Qian looked at Xiao Ye and asked arrogantly.
Xiao Ye did not answer, but stared at Liu Yiyi, the girl who had made him wait for three years. What he needed was Liu Yiyi's answer.
"Brother Xiao..." Liu Yiyi had a complicated expression and bit her red lips.
Looking at the girl so close, Xiao Ye's heart trembled. He took a deep breath and said loudly: "Tell me, are you coming back this time to draw a clear line with us?"
There was a hint of fierceness in Xiao Ye's delicate face, leaving Liu Yiyi at a loss as to how to answer.
"It seems that you can't recognize the reality." Zhao Qian, a young man in white robe, stepped forward with his hands behind his back.He sneered and said, "I have heard Yimei mention you a long time ago. You are the number one genius in Xiaojia Village."
"But in my eyes, you, a genius, are worse than a dog or shit!"
As soon as Zhao Qian finished speaking, a vast and surging energy burst out, sweeping away from him, knocking several villagers around him away, slamming into the wall, and spurting out a mouthful of blood.
"Innate realm!"
Feeling the vast aura, Xiao Dashan trembled in his heart and looked at Zhao Qian in disbelief.
Above the acquired realm is the innate realm!
Warriors in this realm have innate true energy in their bodies and can attack outside the body. They can be called enemies of thousands of people. They can fight among thousands of troops and smash mountain peaks with one punch.
Zhao Qian looks like he is only sixteen years old, but his strength has reached the innate level. You know, in the entire Qingyang Town, there has never been a Xiantian realm warrior.
A sixteen-year-old innate warrior with such qualifications is too terrifying! Is this true genius?
